$comment: Distress cap. High financial NEED (EBIT, interest coverage, debt, leverage, CapEx, cash) can crowd out pilot budget. NOTE: the repository has NO implemented distress cap - only prose caveats in indicators.py / painpoints.py (EBIT, interest coverage) - so there was no existing logic to keep; this file is the first explicit version and is therefore UNCALIBRATED. The caveat flags (rows 50, 51, 72) are always reported. The cap itself only fires once the two TO_CALIBRATE numbers are set; until then the output says distress.status = 'not_calibrated' and lists the candidate variables, and no flag or cap is applied.

trigger.reason_needed: A cutoff on how strongly the Sheet1 status must be present, and how many of the financial variables must agree, before distress is declared.

action.reason_needed: Only used when type is readiness_cap: the maximum READINESS score (0-100) a distressed company may show.
